artifacts.baseline_parameters.json: training-label-only baseline fit state and rules
artifacts.models/*.joblib: locally fitted scikit-learn estimator; load only after checksum verification
artifacts.predictions.csv: local row-level predictions for audit; no native AHS identifier
artifacts.metrics.json: aggregate held-out metrics for both frozen evaluation views
artifacts.experiment_manifest.json: source hashes, fit evidence, parameters, versions, and output hashes
artifacts.qa_experiment_report.json: recomputed artifact, fit-boundary, metric, and reload checks
